label: Classes refinement cannot split
subgoals: Find vertices that an automorphism exchanges
Run refinement to its stable partition
Count the classes with more than one vertex

label: Breaking ties
subgoals: Pick one vertex from each netlist in an ambiguous class
Give the pair a unique colour and refine again
Backtrack if the choice leads to unequal classes

label: Names, permutations and regular arrays
subgoals: Seed the partition with names that both netlists share
Decide whether swapped inputs are declared permutable
Use names or hierarchy to break array symmetry
